implementation_decisions.transport: HTTPS POST to frozen root endpoint with x-api-key header and gzip acceptance
implementation_decisions.rate_limit: request start interval at least 0.65 seconds in one sequential client
implementation_decisions.raw_storage: exact response bytes plus receipt and derivative parquet in append-only retrieval directories
implementation_decisions.resume_authority: receipt fields plus raw and parquet SHA-256; checkpoint alone is never proof
implementation_decisions.opt_daily_scope: entire SSE response is stored before exact 510300 filtering
implementation_decisions.parity_forward_strikes: up to five paired strikes nearest the underlying close
implementation_decisions.iv_surface_strikes: all valid paired strikes inside absolute log-moneyness 0.12, not only the five parity strikes
implementation_decisions.no_arbitrage_bounds: discounted Black-76 intrinsic and upper bounds with only 1e-12 scale numerical epsilon
implementation_decisions.iv_solver: Brent root on frozen 0.01 to 2.00 interval
implementation_decisions.missing_data: explicit NO_VIEW states, no forward fill and no cross-date interpolation
implementation_decisions.clean_replay: second fresh process must reproduce the canonical decision fingerprint from immutable local inputs

tests_cover: credential excluded from request body and persisted outputs
Black-76 call and put IV round trip
exact OP510300.SH contract mapping and adjusted-row preservation

drift_rule: 任何 implementation_files 或协议清单哈希不匹配都以 ProtocolIntegrityError 停止，不允许在本版本中继续调用供应商或读取曲面结果。
